title: Endophytic fungi-assisted synthesis of chitosan-based cerium oxide nanoparticles for the preservation of postharvest fruits
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1890-1900
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00240K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bridget Kpomah, Onome Ejeromedoghene, Abiodun Oladipo, Victor Enwemiwe, Muritala Olusola, Sheriff Adewuyi
Eco-friendly chitosan–CeONPs synthesized using endophytic fungi combat postharvest fruit rot. They reduce moisture loss and extend the shelf life in cherry tomatoes & grapefruits, offering a sustainable preservation method.
